technical.summary: MMM shows isolated bullish technicals (supertrend, squeeze) but lacks momentum confirmation with price below all key moving averages, weak RSI, and no trend strength—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 35 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buy signal from junior member (Ro Khanna) 82+ days old; broad market fear (37/100) presents contrarian opportunity but lacks confirmatory news data and conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (232.6) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 35 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset for multinational MMM.

debate.key_bull_argument: Supertrend bullish + squeeze positive + MACD bullish with price near support (90.05) offers contrarian entry in fear-zone opportunity with potential mean-reversion setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, RSI 38.81 lacks momentum, stochastic 15.32 shows extreme weakness, no trend strength (ADX 11.11), zero fundamental catalysts, earnings risk in 35 days, and macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis) create high-probability failure environment.
